name: 07_depth
prompt: Convert this painting into a clean monocular depth map with exactly the same framing: grayscale only, the nearest blurred foreground elements pure white, the vase and bouquet light-to-mid grey with smooth rounded volume (domed flower heads, cylindrical vase, round stems), the table a smooth gradient from light grey at the bottom to darker grey at the back, and the flat wall the darkest uniform dark grey. Smooth continuous gradients that follow object shapes; no brushstrokes, no texture, no colour, no text.
